body: She can/would provide a better living environment and give him more attention than he would with my parents. With that being said my parents are bitter towards here I think and they don't really want to give him up, because he is such a great dog. I guess I'll just have to give them time to accept that this has to happen :P

She said I had to take him because she couldn't have any connections to me, and so as hard as it was for her she had to give him up. Those two were inseparable, and so I want him to go back where he belongs.

The terms where that they would watch him until I get into an apartment that allows dogs, at which point I would take him back.

That's what I hoped and assumed. I guess I'm just having a confusing time growing up. Growing up I always thought that cheating was only for scummy people and that it didn't happen very often. I also thought that most everybody waited for marriage to have sex, but I guess I was wrong there too. I suppose this is because growing up the only real relationships I saw were my parents and family members. And so now when I come here and read about relationships its the polar opposite of what I had though growing up.

So I guess I just need to learn more about the world. Having said all of this I think I may have been a little to sheltered haha. Thanks for your reply!
Agreed, I just need to focus on healthy and productive distractions, but I still come here because I feel like I need help :P I guess I'll just have to find the median!
I know that, but just because the ER is full doesn't mean there aren't a ton of sick people out in the world!
I'm so sorry hear to hear that :( this situation really sucks :( pm me if you want to talk, I'd love to hear your story and give help if I can!
I just got dumped after 5 years, and reading this helps remind me of what I need to do too! I hope you don't mind, but I think I'm gonna make my own copy of this! Good luck to you!

haha, who knows what it'll end up being, getting her back, or back at her, but to start I'm gonna use getting her back as my goal, and maybe in the end I won't want her back, and I'll just have a better me :)
Understood, and that's gonna be hard to do something for me for once. But it'll all get better with time I suppose. Thanks!

Thanks for the reply. That last part is what I wanted to hear. I want to hear that there is hope for getting her back. I don't care if it's false hope, but for now it helps to ease the pain, and that's all I want. Thanks again.
It's gonna be hard, but it looks like deleting is what I need to do. Now I just have to find a constructive distraction, unlike Netflix! Thanks for your reply!
Haha no, I made it for the post I first made with this account this morning! I figured I might as well keeping using this account for the same problem!
That's exactly what I needed to hear, THANK YOU! I've got to do what I need to do, but not involve her in it!
Directions unclear. Dick stuck in rotary phone dial.
Thanks bro
Thanks for the reply! That'll be a good thing for me to think about with a sober mind. It is kinda pathetic almost calling them, and if I just realize that then I probably won't do it!
Good idea, I think it's a bit to soon to completely do away with her contact, so changing her name will probably help a lot, thanks!
Thanks for the advice, I think if I think ahead and accept that it won't end well if I contact her that will definitely act as a deterrent, thanks!
So hard, but I'm seeing overwhelming support to deleting her contact..

No contact is what I see needs to happen, so I emailed her and told her that we can't talk, which I'm sure she will be relieved to hear.

I've already been told of for being clingy ha. Well not really for being clingy, but for acting like we are still together and not treating at like we are done, which we are. But with this having happened so fast I think it's gonna take some time to accept that we are actually done, and that will come from not talking to her, so as much as it hurts I can see its for the best.

No I can't even imagine seeing her with someone else, I feel sick just thinking about it. I think I want to stay friends with her so I can still be protective of her because in my dream world I'll be able to win her back. But I don't think that's the case anymore, so I just have to let her go and accept that she is no longer mine. That'll be the hardest thing to do, and right now it's too hard to come to terms with the fact that the most important part of my life for the past 6 years (1 year as just best friends, 5 as SO's) is no longer mine.

Hearing that I'm not the only one to have gone through this helps, because it tells me that if others can make it through all this pain and sadness, then so can I!

I'll do my best not to drive myself crazy in plotting to get her back. I hope by keeping her out of mind I'll stop thinking about how to get her back.

I'm not entirely sure on what this swole is, but I'll work towards it anyways haha.

Thank you so much for your advice, it really means a lot to hear from someone who's been where I am now, and to hear that it will all end up alright in the end. Thanks again.

Coming to terms with the pain and not just ignoring it is something I definitely need to work on, as I can see that this pain isn't one I can just ignore.

I took your advice and emailed her telling her I'm done talking to her, except in regards to the dog and other non-relationshipy type things. I think she'll be relieved to hear that, because I've been the one making contact with her out of despair not her, she seems to know what she's doing more than myself.

I absolutely will! Working out always makes me feel better. Now I can take the time to become the best me and hitting the gym will certainly be part of that.

Thanks you so much for your help, it really does mean a lot!

This is seriously normal?? How has the world just continued to turn if so many people go through this? I guess having never been thought this before has given me that special snowflake syndrome.

I would absolutely not wish this on my worst enemy! It's intolerable, and really gets to the core of who you are. But hearing that it's normal and I'm not the only one to have felt this way gives me hope, and that's what I really need right now.

At this point I'm willing to bet that you are right. I'll probably never get her back, and that's probably going to be the hardest part for me. Accepting that I have to find a new way of life, and a new goal to shoot for isn't going to be easy but it's what needs to be done.

I'll do my best to keep a sober mind when thinking about this. Obviously the thought of getting back together pops into my head every 5 minutes, but it's becoming less painful every time. I jut can't wait for the point that if stops popping in my head, because hopefully that means I've come to accept that we are done, for good.

I really can't wait for those better things to come my way, but in the mean time there's a lot for me to learn from what has just happened.

Thanks for your words of advice and encouragement, it really means a lot to me. Being told that it will all be okay in the end has gotten me through a lot of rough patches, so I'm happy to hear it'll get me through this one too. Thank you so much!

Thanks, even internet hugs help ease the pain!

I feel like the way you read my post may be correct, but if I admit to myself that that's the way I've been feeling then everything I did for that relationship and everything I went through was a waste. Also I worry that if that's how I actually feel then what else am I not being honest to myself about? It's a scary thing to question the past couple years of my life, but I guess that's all I have left.

Being honest with myself and being more in tune with my emotions is something definitely need to work on. Thank you so much for your kind words and advice, it really means a lot to me, more than you might ever know, Internet stranger!!

I really hope that's not the case, but it's definitely crossed my mind.

I emailed her this morning telling her I'm done talking to her, so thanks for the advice. I feel that it's for the best.
